node.statement: The hypotheses of lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope hold for the displayed A,w and every nonempty subset in question; applying it to R gives A_R as an extended L^0*epsilon-C*-algebra and bounds every stated projection, subordination, and complementarity error for U subseteq R by L^0*epsilon. Since W.L>=L^0, record the monotone upper ambient parameter epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon; then A_R is an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra and all these errors are at most epsilon_R<=t_2.
